answer: In an agent market trading ferrous scrap, gale forecasts, and lotus seeds, each seller must lock a $100 bond for 30 days before receiving one daily auction slot. Slots scale with bonded capital, not account count, so splitting funds among fake identities creates no extra capacity. An attacker seeking 1,000 slots must immobilize $100,000, paying financing costs throughout the lockup rather than merely generating new keys.
